newsitem.title: THAILAND: Furukawa Metal debuts at 30 baht/share.
newsitem.headline: Furukawa Metal debuts at 30 baht/share.

text.p: Seamless copper tube producer Furukawa Metal (Thailand) Plc debuted on the Thai stock exchange at 30 baht against its IPO price of 45 baht.
Furukawa fluctuated in a 28.50-32.00 baht range during the first 14 minutes of trade. It ranked sixth on the early morning active list.
The company floated 14.5 million shares through its initial public offer.

"At an IPO price of 45 baht, Furukawa Metal is quite pricey. Investors may be hesitant to buy it while the market is on a steep downward trend. They may consider buying it if it is cheaper," said Somchai Trairattanapirom of SITCA Investment and Securities.
The company had sought to postpone its debut on the bourse several times since mid-1996 because of the market's prolonged bearishness, brokers said.
